result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a meaningless '-0%' promo badge on the pizza card and inconsistent styling of wishlist heart buttons.

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' displays a '-0%' badge, which is meaningless and looks like a broken discount calculation
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when discount is 0% or fix the backend value to show the correct discount percentage

issues.description: Favorite heart icons are inconsistent: ramen card heart has no background container while pizza card heart has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button style for all wishlist hearts with the same circular background, size, and contrast
